clauses.requirement: Where the vertical angle of geometric visibility below the horizontal may be reduced to 5° (lamp mounted less than 750 mm above the ground, measured per paragraph 5.8.1), the photometric field of measurements of the installed optical unit may be reduced to 5° below the horizontal.
For an interdependent lamp system, the geometric visibility requirements shall be fulfilled when all its interdependent lamps are operated together.
A LED module need not be replaceable if this is stated in the communication sheet of the component type approval.

All lamps (devices) installed on the vehicle shall, where applicable, be type approved according to the corresponding device Regulations as specified in the relevant subparagraphs of paragraph 6 of UN R48.
In case a light-signalling lamp incorporates a manufacturer logo, the lamp shall be type approved according to the requirements of UN Regulation No. 148.

Lamps installed on a vehicle approved for one or more replaceable light source categories according to Regulations Nos. 37, 99 or 128 shall be fitted only with light sources approved according to those categories; this does not apply to light source modules, LED modules and non-replaceable light sources, except where they are required to be approved by the applicable Regulation.

If an external status indicator for Vehicle Alarm System (VAS), Alarm System (AS) or immobilizer is fitted, one is allowed provided light intensity in any direction does not exceed 0.5 cd, emitted colour is white, red or amber, and apparent surface area is not larger than 20 cm²; up to two such indicators are allowed on a vehicle provided the apparent surface does not exceed 10 cm² per indicator.

A device type approved to any preceding series of amendments to UN Regulations Nos. 148, 149 and/or 150 is deemed equivalent to one approved to the latest series when the change indexes (paragraph 2.1.6) for each individual lamp (function) do not differ; such a device may be fitted on the vehicle to be type approved without update of device type approval documents and markings.
